title: Myota event envelope (CloudEvents 1.0 subset)
description: The shape of `ops.outbox_event.payload`. A subset of CloudEvents 1.0: the attributes the system actually sets, with the ones it does not use left out rather than declared optional-but-never-present. `data` is constrained by the per-type file, not here — the envelope is one document for every event type, and a per-type `data` schema belongs in the per-type file.

specversion.description: CloudEvents version. Const because there is one version in use.

id.description: The event id. On the consuming side this becomes the job id, which is what makes a duplicate delivery a no-op rather than a double count.

source.description: The producing service, as a path: `/core`, `/geodata`, `/activity`.

subject.description: `<aggregate>:<uuid>`. The partition is computed from this, so every event about one aggregate is ordered relative to the others.

time.description: When the fact became true, not when it was published.

data.description: The payload. Constrained by the per-type schema.
